versions.name: Show song info on LevelList
versions.description: Lets you click the song name

about:
# *This mod lets you click the song name in the level list view.*

literally you can click the <cg>song's</c> <cy>name</c> on <cj>ONLINE LEVEL</c> or every <cr>levelList</c> view
changelog:
# v1.0.0
- hello geode.
- you can click the song's name.
